                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The phrase 'The cholera' is incorrect in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Cholera is an uncountable noun and does not require an article ('the') in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In English, diseases are typically not preceded by the definite article 'the'.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: Correct: Cholera is a frightful disease. Incorrect: The cholera is a frightful disease.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Correct sentence: Cholera is a frightful disease.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \nAdditional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Articles ('a', 'an', 'the') are generally not used with uncountable nouns (like diseases, ideas, etc.).\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: Happiness is essential for a healthy life.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • When referring to specific, well-known entities or unique items, 'the' is appropriate.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: The Sun rises in the East.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Common countable nouns require articles depending on their definiteness.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: A cat sits on the roof.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Contextual Fit: The phrase "set ____ against its background" requires a preposition that implies inclusion or placement within a context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Common Usage: The preposition 'in' is commonly used with the verb 'set' to indicate the positioning of something within a particular framework or background (e.g., "set in motion", "set in context").
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Correct Syntax: The correct syntactic structure for describing something being placed against a background is "set in".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Literary Context: When discussing literary pieces, using 'in' to denote the backdrop or context where something is placed is grammatically accurate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Meaning: 'In' accurately conveys the sense of an essay being framed within its background, aligning with the intended meaning of the passage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
